_facts: CLAIMS-american587.md §A.2 and ANCHORS: c81 22-lb breakout force and 4-in maximum pedal travel (AAR p.18); c84 135 KCAS row — 65 lb / 4.0 in / 30° (Table 3, p.23); c83 250 KCAS row — 32 lb / 1.2 in (Table 3); c82 9.3° rudder limit at 250 kt (Table 2); Findings 11 and 14 verbatim (AAR p.160, CLAIMS §A.2); c75 N14053; c01 accident date; c139 adopted 2004-10-26. The page is a typeset stand-in so the scene can zoom to the two rows that matter; the actual AAR page scans (PD) are DocWide ExhibitScenes in the same chapter. Gaps are labelled 'not reproduced' rather than filled. The 135-knot row's airspeed is written in words because ANCHORS c84 carries '135 KCAS' only in its unit cell, not its value cell — move it into the value cell and the digits can return.
